description: This Dart source file defines utility functions and classes to support deterministic, cross-platform golden testing in Flutter. It includes methods to load test images and fonts, configure golden file comparisons, and wrap widgets with stable testing environments to ensure consistent golden test results.

classes.name: GoldenTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods and constants to assist with deterministic golden testing in Flutter, including image provisioning, widget wrapping for testing, font loading, and golden file configuration.

methods.name: stableTestImageProvider
methods.description: Returns an ImageProvider backed by a small, deterministic PNG image to be used in golden tests for consistent image comparison.

methods.name: harness
methods.description: Wraps a widget with a consistent MaterialApp and MediaQuery environment, stabilizing layout and text metrics during golden tests.

methods.name: configureGoldens
methods.description: Configures the golden file comparator to use a predictable base directory (`test/`) for golden image files.

methods.name: loadTestFont
methods.description: Loads a known font ('Ahem.ttf') into the test environment to stabilize text rendering in golden tests.

methods.name: pumpForGolden
methods.description: Pumps the widget and allows animations and frames to settle to ensure stable golden image capture.

methods.name: goldenPath
methods.description: Generates the relative file path under `test/goldens/` for a given golden image filename.
